name: status-pane
description: A side pane with the session at a glance: idle time, weekly usage and pace, workspace, focus, task, model, context and cost.

warnMinutes.title: Yellow zone, in minutes
warnMinutes.description: The usage bar turns yellow when, at the current rate, the weekly limit would be hit within this many minutes before it resets. Sooner than that, it turns red.
